qualification.details: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): First Class Postgraduate Degree (including integrated PG degrees) in Pediatrics, Neonatology, Nursing, Public Health, Epidemiology, Clinical Research, from a recognized university. Second Class Postgraduate Degree (including integrated PG degrees) in Pediatrics, Neonatology, Nursing, Public Health, Epidemiology, Clinical Research with Ph.D. from a recognized university. Minimum of two years' prior experience in government-funded research projects, particularly in the area of Maternal and Child Health. Project Nurse III: Diploma in General Nursing or Midwife. Registration with the State/Indian Nursing Council. BSc. Nursing with experience of working in labour room, maternity ward, neonatal care, and clinical research projects. Candidates with prior experience of minimum 6 months in any govt. funded research project will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical) and 3 for Project Nurse III.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): First Class Postgraduate Degree (including integrated PG degrees) in Pediatrics, Neonatology, Nursing, Public Health, Epidemiology, Clinical Research, from a recognized university. Second Class Postgraduate Degree (including integrated PG degrees) in Pediatrics, Neonatology, Nursing, Public Health, Epidemiology, Clinical Research with Ph.D. from a recognized university. Minimum of two years' prior experience in government-funded research projects, particularly in the area of Maternal and Child Health. Project Nurse III: Diploma in General Nursing or Midwife. Registration with the State/Indian Nursing Council. BSc. Nursing with experience of working in labour room, maternity ward, neonatal care, and clinical research projects. Candidates with prior experience of minimum 6 months in any govt. funded research project will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the posts of Project Research Scientist-I and Project Nurse-III at AIIMS Jodhpur is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced by AIIMS Jodhpur for the positions of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and Project Nurse - III.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: For Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical), candidates need a First Class Postgraduate Degree or a Second Class Postgraduate Degree with Ph.D. in relevant fields like Pediatrics, Neonatology, Nursing, Public Health, Epidemiology, or Clinical Research.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for Project Nurse - III?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for Project Nurse - III must possess a Diploma in General Nursing or Midwife and be registered with the State/Indian Nursing Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and Project Nurse - III is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Project Research Scientist-I will receive a consolidated salary of ₹67,200 per month, which includes ₹56,000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Project Nurse - III?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Project Nurse - III will receive a consolidated salary of ₹33,600 per month, which includes ₹28,000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive by AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to appear in person for the interview with all required documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur), Rajasthan, 342005.
